name: Cultist Axe

pages.text: Obtain as a rare equipment drop from armed Luminous Nether cultists. It is a durable, fast axe and melee weapon.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Find Piglin Cultists and Cultist Riders from Luminous Nether. They spawn with this axe in their main hand. Fungal Plains is associated with the cultist group.

pages.title: How to obtain
pages.text: Defeat a cultist that holds the axe. It drops through native mob-equipment rules, so the drop is rare. Looting improves equipment-drop chances. There is no crafting-grid recipe.

pages.title: Purpose
pages.text: This is a native axe tool and melee weapon. Its installed material has 1200 durability, mining speed 6 and attack bonus 5. Use normal axe actions for wood and combat.
